objective_value: <float> Expected makespan across all scenarios, weighted by scenario probabilities.
assignment: <dict, key: '{job}'> Facility to which each job is assigned before uncertainty is revealed.

{job}.facility: <int> Facility on which this job is processed in this scenario.
{job}.start: <int> Time at which this job begins processing in this scenario.
{job}.finish: <int> Time at which this job completes processing in this scenario.
